svg.title: Long-term memory contents for the AI PM Copilot
svg.desc: Structural diagram showing five categories stored in long-term memory: project knowledge, team knowledge, decision log, compressed context, and code and quality signals.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What project knowledge does the copilot store long-term?')
sendPrompt('What team knowledge does the copilot remember?')
sendPrompt('How does the copilot log decisions over time?')
sendPrompt('What is compressed context in long-term memory?')
sendPrompt('What code and quality signals does the copilot track long-term?')

svg.text: Written at session end or on compression · Read at session start via RAG retrieval
Context about the project and team
